Badge source is still unclear?

messages.content: I need to build the Kansas City/Lenexa trip for the distributor winterization training. Travel Tuesday after my 10:30 PT forecast call; class starts Wednesday 8:30, and there may be a Thursday contractor breakfast. I need flight, rental car, and hotel options. One stop max, no long layover. For hotels, compare a good Lenexa spot near dinner and parking against a cheaper airport stay. Keep the hotel rating at 4.0+ if there’s a decent choice, and check coffee/fridge.
Got it. What exact Tuesday and Thursday dates, and are SFO, OAK, and SJC all acceptable? Also, do you want me to include a Wednesday-night return if the breakfast falls off?

Tuesday Jan 21 outbound, class Wednesday Jan 22. Hold both return paths: after customer dinner Wednesday, or Thursday Jan 23 after breakfast. SFO is easiest, OAK is acceptable if timing is cleaner; skip SJC. United is fine, but don’t chase it if a different carrier makes Tuesday less rushed.
Before I shortlist: what time can you realistically get to the Lenexa branch Tuesday, and is the demo case confirmed there?

Branch manager can wait until 7:00 p.m. if I give him a firm ETA. Demo case is still in freight; I need enough margin to look at it Tuesday night if it arrives. Budget is normal corporate; don’t waste money, but don’t put me at KCI if it blows up Wednesday morning.

Best fit on timing: Southwest OAK-MCI nonstop, depart about 12:45 p.m., arrive 5:55 p.m. CT; that puts you at the rental counter around 6:20 and Lenexa close to 7:00 if traffic cooperates. Acceptable United option: SFO-DEN-MCI, depart about 1:20, 65-minute Denver connection, arrive around 8:05; better for loyalty, worse for the branch check. Backup: American via DFW, depart about 12:30, arrive 7:45; one connection but less clean than the nonstop.
Is the OAK departure too tight after the call?

If the call ends at 10:30 sharp, it is workable but not generous: leave by 10:45, reach OAK about 11:25-11:35, and avoid checking a bag if you can. If the call slips, the United SFO one-stop is safer at the front end but sacrifices the demo-case check.
No checked bag unless I have samples. What about hotels?

Lenexa shortlist: 1) Hyatt Place Kansas City/Lenexa City Center, about 10 minutes from the branch, Google around 4.4, free parking, included breakfast, rooms list mini-fridge and coffeemaker, several dinner places in the City Center area. 2) SpringHill Suites Lenexa City Center, around 4.5, similar parking and breakfast, fridge/coffeemaker/microwave listed, slightly farther. Cheaper KCI-area backup: Hampton Inn KCI, around 4.2 and cheaper, but 35-50 minutes to Lenexa Wednesday and weaker dinner logistics.
Between those Lenexa two, which is better for an 8:30 classroom start?

Hyatt Place is the cleaner work fit: shorter drive to the distributor, easier parking, and enough nearby dinner options that you won’t have to hunt after checking the case. SpringHill is acceptable if the rate is meaningfully lower; it looks a touch stronger on reviews but doesn’t improve the morning.
Breakfast start time matters if I have to be at the branch around 8.

Both list weekday breakfast starting at 6:30. I’d still ask before booking whether coffee is available earlier and whether a grab-and-go is possible, since you may leave around 7:35-7:45 depending on setup.
Parking and dinner: any hidden issue?

Parking is free self-park at both Lenexa options. Hyatt has several nearby casual dinner spots and a short drive to more; SpringHill is similar but a little more spread out. The KCI backup has parking, but you’d be eating around airport hotels and adding the longer morning drive.
Give me the rental car piece. Compact SUV should be enough.

Use an on-airport compact SUV at MCI with pickup 6:15-6:30 p.m. if you take the nonstop. That leaves a 30-40 minute drive to Lenexa. I’d avoid off-airport agencies for this one; saving a few dollars could cost the branch-check window.
For return, show the tradeoff but don’t decide it yet.

Wednesday return works only if dinner ends early: late nonstop or one-stop options leave roughly 8:45-9:40 p.m., and any slip makes rental return stressful. Thursday is cleaner: attend a 7:30 breakfast if it stays on, leave Lenexa around 9:00, and take a late-morning or midday MCI-OAK/SFO option. For now I’d hold Tuesday OAK-MCI nonstop, compact SUV, Hyatt Place Lenexa, and Thursday-morning return as the best fit; United via Denver and SpringHill are acceptable backups. Ask before booking: demo case arrival and whether the Thursday breakfast is real.

messages.content: Update on Lenexa: demo case will be at the branch by Tuesday noon, but the class expanded and they want me onsite 7:45 Wednesday for room setup. Narrow this. It’s really the Tuesday nonstop versus the United one-stop now.

With the 7:45 setup, the Tuesday nonstop is the better operational fit. OAK-MCI lands about 5:55 CT; with rental pickup you can still reach the branch around 6:50-7:05 and see the case. The United SFO-DEN-MCI gets in about 8:05; by the time you get the car and reach Lenexa, the branch check is gone.
Use the nonstop if it still lets me finish the forecast call. Any reason not to?

Main drawback is OAK logistics and less carrier flexibility. If the call slips past 10:40, it gets uncomfortable. Otherwise it avoids a connection and protects the demo-case check. I’d make United the backup only if the nonstop price jumps or the call time moves.
Hotel: confirm the Lenexa choice, not the airport.

Hyatt Place Lenexa is the pick. It’s closer to the branch than the KCI hotels, parking is free, rating is solid, and dinner options are nearby enough for Tuesday after you inspect the case. The airport stay is cheaper but puts a 40-ish minute drive in front of a 7:45 setup.
Do we actually know coffee maker and mini-fridge are in the room?
Yes. I checked the room details for the standard king: mini-fridge and coffeemaker are listed. Breakfast starts at 6:30; lobby coffee is available earlier, but hot breakfast won’t be before 6:30.
Good. Rental timing?
Book the compact SUV at the MCI terminal counter, pickup 6:15 p.m. Tuesday. Return depends on the flight, but staying with an on-airport counter keeps it simple. No off-airport shuttle.
Return still depends. Dinner Wednesday is now 5:30 to maybe 7 in Lenexa. Breakfast Thursday is 7:30 but could get canceled.

Wednesday night is doable only if dinner ends right at 7 and you accept a rushed drive and rental return or a late connection. It’s not a good fit after a full training day. Thursday morning is cleaner: breakfast 7:30-8:30, depart Lenexa about 8:40, and target a flight after 11.
Hold Thursday. If breakfast cancels, I can work from the hotel lobby and still fly late morning. No airport hotel.

Then the narrowed plan is Tuesday OAK-MCI nonstop, Hyatt Place Lenexa for two nights, compact SUV at MCI, and Thursday late-morning return. I’d use an 11:50-ish MCI-OAK option if it’s still available; it gives enough buffer after breakfast without wasting the whole day.
Correct. Don’t book until Greg confirms breakfast by 3, but prepare that set.

Prepared and on hold. Best fit: nonstop outbound plus Hyatt Lenexa and Thursday late-morning return. Acceptable backup: United via Denver only if the nonstop falls apart. Ask before booking: Greg’s breakfast confirmation and any change to the 7:45 setup time.
